title: Alberto C NDE 9777
content: It was my cousin’s 15th birthday. During lunch, our group of friends were going to eat at a local fast-food chain called Wendy’s. I had to stay behind to pick up my uniform from the cleaners. I was jaywalking and remember a minivan had stopped to let me cross the road. I did not see the jeep behind the minivan. As I ran, I was hit by the jeep and knocked unconscious. I remember seeing myself sleeping with my head down in my first period English class. I felt that I needed to wake up to go to my next class. I could hear my fellow students and truly felt like I was still in my first period class. Then I woke up to firemen asking me for my parents' contact information. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 01/28/2007 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death. I woke up covered with a blanket and firemen/EMTs ran to me How do you consider the content of your experience? Neither pleasant NOR distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. Slightly heightened alertness At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Hearing people around me speaking Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Probably about the same Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could hear so many voices but unsure to pinpoint actual words or who was speaking Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return?
